plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control hallmark pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: Differential expression (DESeq2 Wald test, treated=psoriasis-lesional vs control=untreated skin, 6 vs 6, from the delivered de_results.csv on 12000 genes) is already complete and is treated as an inherited input, not re-run. Sample sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median, so the first step is a sample-structure QC pass over the delivered counts to establish whether this sample is an outlier in PCA/sample-distance space and whether it should qualify interpretation of the enrichment. The core analysis answers 'which hallmark pathways change' with a preranked fgsea GSEA using the DESeq2 Wald statistic (stat column) from de_results.csv against the MSigDB Hallmark human collection (50 sets), which is staged in the reference store — the disputed ranking-metric choice is resolved here as the Wald statistic per the knowledge base's stated default, and the full ranked list of tested genes is used (no pre-thresholding) because a preranked test on the complete list finds coordinated small-effect signal that a cut list would discard. A second enrichment pass against Reactome and WikiPathways-human extends interpretation of any hallmark hit to a specific curated pathway, following the standard order (Hallmark first, then Reactome/WikiPathways). All enrichment uses a 15-500 gene size window, BH-adjusted q-values, redundancy collapse, and reports leading-edge genes for every significant set. A final report step consolidates the enrichment tables, states the QC caveat about sample_01, states the ranking-metric and identifier-mapping choices, and includes the full reproducibility record (package versions, collection releases, seeds).
